messages:
Priya: Follow-up to the quant profiles RFC. Proposal: separate 'capability artifacts' (immutable, signed) from 'runtime hints' (mutable, low-latency). Keeps guarantees clean and gives ops fast controls.

Diego: What's inside each artifact?

Priya: Capability artifact = supported lanes (fp8/int8/4bit), quality anchors (tolerances per-cohort), canonical fallback sequence, and an integrity hash. Runtime hint = per-request/account hint: pin, canary, emergency opt-out, and sample-rate tweaks.

Noah: Compatibility question: customers use per-layer calibration outputs today. How do we transition?

Lina: Adapter approach: at deploy-time, materialize capability -> per-layer profile using our calibration transforms. Cache the result keyed by (capability_hash, adapter_version). Runtime keeps existing per-layer consumer code intact.

Diego: Telemetry must capture lane-specific deltas. Suggest: deg_score, tokenwise-SNR, prompt-cohort breakdown, and shadow-sample traces.

Priya: Agree. Also need an operator API to bump shadow_sample_rate per-account when ramping.

Sam: Storage: capabilities should be content-addressed (sha256). Node-friendly alias names OK but not canonical. Make artifacts immutable.

Noah: Example capability (informal): 
```
profile_name: "fp8-core-2026-02"
lanes: ["fp8","int8"]
quality_anchor: "<=0.6% perplexity increase"
fallback: ["int8","float16"]
```

Lina: Policy resolution: server evaluates (customer_hint, ops_override, policy_hysteresis) in that order and picks the most conservative allowed lane.

Diego: Hysteresis details: define windows+thresholds. Eg: if deg_score > 0.8 for 5m -> demote to int8 for 15m. If latency breaches 99p SLO by >30% -> immediate fallback. SRE to set numbers.

Sam: API ergonomics: allow precision: auto|fp8|int8|float16 and quality_budget param. Example: POST /v1/generate { precision: "auto", quality_budget: "0.5%" }

Priya: Ops/rollout plan: 48-72h shadowing, then staged ramp (1,5,20,50,100) with automatic rollback on telemetry triggers. Add a manual abort path.

Noah: QA: canonical prompt pack + hallucination/regression checks. Run smoke on adapter PRs and in canary pipeline.

Lina: Regulated tenants: account flag safe_mode=true that disallows lowbit lanes unless explicit legal/ops acceptance. We'll enforce at admission.

Sam: Add audit logs for any ops_override/customer_hint uses. Make logs human-searchable and tie to incident IDs.

Priya: Owners: Priya (adapter + artifacts), Noah (telemetry + dashboards), SRE (canary/hysteresis), Sam (API). I'll open adapter proto PR by next Tue.

Diego: +1. ops-bot, can you schedule canary window?

ops-bot: canary scheduled 1807770065 UTC window=72h; will create canary env and post updates.

Noah: Small runtime note: evaluate policy at routing and immediately before dispatch so last-mile ops_override is allowed.

Priya: Good call. Also ensure minimal performance cost for adapter cache lookup. Use LRU keyed by (cap_hash, adapter_version).

Sam: I'll draft API doc with examples and pin semantics.

Lina: QA will prepare smoke set and CI gating rules.

Priya: Thanks everyone. I'll post PR link when opened.
